item.text: I’m going to reproduce the CI failure path for JSC-246, inspect the routing validator code, and patch only the defect that breaks HE routing while keeping the rest of the behavior intact. After that I’ll run the narrow validation path again so we can see the fix in isolation.

The local shell is being blocked by the sandbox, so I’m checking whether this workspace exposes the repo through any available resource channel before I give up on reproduction. If it does, I can still narrow the fix without guessing.

I can’t reproduce or fix this one from the current environment because every local shell command is being blocked by the sandbox before it can read the repo. I also don’t have any mounted repo resources to inspect, so I can’t see the routing validator code or the failing CI path.

What I need to continue is one of these:
1. A workspace mode that allows local read access to the repo, or
2. The exact failing CI command/output for JSC-246, plus the file path for the HE routing validator.

If you can share either, I’ll pick up from there and make the smallest possible fix.
